summary: Staff reported that the Lofts at Fairgrounds applied for preliminary plan approval for a 275-unit complex. A 70-unit apartment building at South County Commons District 5 Apartments also applied for preliminary plan approval. Staff also described possible changes to the Old Tower Hill Road form-based code after a Council meeting.
decisions: Continued discussion of the Westerly State Training Facility tour to the next meeting.
Continued discussion of resuming SMART Committee statistical work to the next meeting.
Continued discussion of a future URI medical school to the next meeting.
Deferred discussion of EDC collaboration with other town boards to the November meeting.
Deferred discussion of EDC surveys to the next meeting.
Deferred discussion of the South Kingstown Garden Show to the next meeting.

decision_titles: Tour of Westerly State Training Facility
Absorption of SMART Committee work into EDC
EDC collaboration with other town boards
plain_text:
Town of South Kingstown   
Economic Development Commission   
Meeting Minutes 
Wednesday, October 7, 2026 at 6:00 PM   
Town Hall Council Chambers 
180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
Michael Gagas, Chair 
Randy Apuzzo, Vice Chair 
Thomas Routliffe 
Ken Tetzner 
Susan Marcus 
Ian Clark 
Jack Cadman 
Kirk Brown 
Gerry Schaffert 
Ibrahim Fofanah 
-- vacancy --  
A. Call to Order & Roll Call 
The meeting was called to order at: 06:02 PM by Randy Apuzzo as acting Chair in the absence of Michael Gagas. 
Members Present:  Randy Apuzzo, Kirk Brown, Jack Cadman, Tom Routliffe, Ken Tetzner, Ibrahim Fofanah 
Members Absent:  Michael Gagas, Susan Marcus, Ian Clark, Gerry Schaffert 
Staff:  Brian Wagner  
B. Approval of Minutes: 
 1. 9/2/2026 Draft Minutes 
A motion to approve the minutes of 9/2/2026 was made by Jack Cadman. The motion was seconded by Kirk Brown. 
Upon a vote by all members present, the motion was approved unanimously. 
C. Correspondence & Public Comment: 
Presentation by staff of any correspondence issued or received by the EDC since the previous meeting & receipt of 
any public comment of a general nature that is not connected to a current agenda item. No action will be taken by 
the EDC on any correspondence or comment not specifically referenced in the agenda. 
None. 
D. Old Business: 
 1. Tour of Westerly State Training Facility - Follow-Up Discussion 
Mr. Brown reviewed the tour. A brief discussion followed before it was agreed to continue the discussion to the next 
meeting when Mr. Gagas (who had set up the tour) could participate. 
 2. Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Plan - Follow-up discussion on Council consideration of Form Based 
Code. 
Mr. Brown provided a synopsis of the 9/21/2026 Council meeting that he attended. A discussion followed. Mr. Wagner 
outlined some proposals for changes to the code that staff were considering in response to comments made at the 
meeting, including: the removal of the FB1 district, reduction of the FB2 district, and ideas to address concerns about 
nonconforming uses. Mr. Wagner also noted that: 
o No objection was noted to residential expansion into the core. 
o Concerns were raised about additional density in the R10 and R20 zones, but that the new FB1 district was 
created to establish bedroom limits and design standards for building form. 
o Gas & service stations are "grandfathered" uses under the FBC and can pass with the property. If a 
nonconforming building burns, it can be rebuilt.  
o Town Council response was characterized as good with questions including water.
o The public hearing with Council was continued to Tuesday October 13th. 
 
E. New Business: 
 1. Absorption of SMART Committee Work into EDC - Discussion of resuming the statistical analysis work 
formerly delegated to the SMART Committee. 
Mr. Wagner noted that the duties of the former SMART committee had been returned to the EDC. Members agreed to 
continue the discussion to the next meeting so that Susan Marcus would be present and could help inform the EDC 
about what the SMART committee had been doing. 
 2. Future URI Medical School - General discussion about working with URI. 
Members briefly discussed the new dorm construction on campus before continuing the discussion to the next meeting 
so that Mr. Schaffert could be in attendance. 
 3. EDC Collaboration With Other Town Boards 
Discussion deferred to the November meeting so that Mr. Gagas could be in attendance. 
F. Staff Update & Planning Department Activities: 
Presentation by staff of any new project applications received by the Planning Department and any activities by 
the Planning Department with potential economic impacts for the town. No action will be taken by the EDC on 
any information presented by staff unless specifically referenced in the agenda. 
 1. Lofts at Fairgrounds - Preliminary Plan application received by Planning Dept. 
Mr. Wagner informed the EDC that the apartment project had submitted its application for Preliminary Plan approval for 
the 275-unit complex. A discussion followed. 
 2. South County Commons District 5 Apartments - Preliminary Plan application received by Planning Dept. 
Mr. Wagner informed the EDC that the applicants had submitted their application for Preliminary Plan approval for a 70-
unit apartment building. A discussion followed. 
G. Recurring Discussion Topics: 
 1. EDC Surveys - Discussion regarding survey data collection, results & next steps. 
Discussion was deferred to the next meeting. A question was asked about survey participation by town employees. 
 2. South Kingstown Garden Show - Continued discussion of conceptual event. 
Discussion was deferred to the next meeting. 
H. New Discussion Issues & Future Agenda Items: 
Proposed discussion topics for November included the Form-Based Code and how to solicit philanthropic support for 
town development projects. 
I. Adjournment: 
A motion was made to adjourn the meeting by Tom Routliffe. The motion was seconded by Ken Tetzner and the meeting 
adjourned by unanimous consent at 07:43 PM.
